name: @pipeworx/mcp-prayer-times

tools.name: prayer_times
tools.description: Islamic prayer times (salah times: Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, plus Imsak and Midnight) for a location today. Provide either city+country or latitude+longitude. Returns timings, Gregorian and Hijri (Islamic calendar) dates, timezone, and the calculation method used.

country.description: Country name or code, e.g. "UK". Requires city.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Use with longitude as an alternative to city+country.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Use with latitude.

method.description: Prayer-time calculation method. Default 2 = ISNA (Islamic Society of North America); 3 = MWL (Muslim World League); 4 = Umm al-Qura (Makkah); and others.

tools.name: qibla
tools.description: Qibla direction (compass bearing toward the Kaaba in Mecca) for a given latitude/longitude, in degrees from true north.

tools.name: convert_to_hijri
tools.description: Convert a Gregorian date to the Hijri (Islamic) calendar date. Useful for Islamic calendar date conversion.

date.description: Gregorian date in DD-MM-YYYY format, e.g. "07-06-2026".

tools.name: hijri_calendar
tools.description: Monthly Islamic prayer-times calendar for a city: per-day Gregorian and Hijri (Islamic calendar) dates with salah times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Maghrib, Isha).

method.description: Prayer-time calculation method. Default 2 = ISNA; 3 = MWL; 4 = Umm al-Qura; and others.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-prayer-times forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the prayer-times pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
